_doc: Continuity bible. Every anchor_description is injected VERBATIM into every prompt that references the id, so wording must stay frozen once approved. Generative shots that show a character require consented reference images (consent.status == 'signed') before generation is allowed.

global_look.anchor_description: contemporary Saudi Arabia, authentic and respectful cultural detail, natural warm daylight palette leaning to deep green, warm beige and muted gold accents, premium but understated, photorealistic cinematic commercial

grade.notes: Warm neutral highlights, gentle contrast, no teal-orange push.

global_look.aspect_framing_rule: Compose with a centre-safe area so 9:16 and 16:9 can both be generated natively; keep faces and key action inside the central 56% width.

negative_prompt_global: any on-screen text, letters, captions, subtitles or Arabic script
app screens, phone UI, website UI, dashboards
distorted hands, extra fingers, warped faces, uncanny eyes
identity drift, changing face or wardrobe between shots
ribbon cutting, scissors, alarm or notification visuals
alcohol, immodest clothing, culturally inaccurate dress
low resolution, flicker, jitter, morphing, cartoon look
